skill.summary: Timezone-aware NBA daily intelligence using bundled public ESPN/NBA fetchers plus official NBA injury-report PDFs, with compact day fast path, same-day stats...

latestVersion.changelog:
NBA Today Pulse v1.0.15 - Minor update following thin-wrapper contract and removing test harness.

- Removes the internal test harness file `tools/verify_nba_tr.py` from the public bundle.
- Updates documentation (SKILL.md) to clarify that only the intended execution wrapper and official route separation are supported.
- Confirms `official_report` summaries are a dedicated route and cannot be mixed into other reports.
- Adjusts and simplifies the description for clarity and accurate feature scope.
- No changes to external commands, parameters, or end-user experience.
